c74object.name: evi_ssb
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_ssb.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_ssb.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_ssb.genexpr file also requires:
evi_sinfold_lib.genexpr
evi_cossin.genexpr
evi_biquads_extras.genexpr
evi_rcfilters.genexpr
evi_butterworth.genexpr
About this File:
This file is mainly here as a catch all for the require files it inherits for building the evieve SSB (Single SideBand) modulators. It also contains the 'complexRing()' required for those abstractions.

entry.name: complexRing ( )
entry.description:
Real/Imag complex ring modulator component
In 1: type=input: real, Real signal input
In 2: type=input: imag, Imag signal input
In 3: type=input: rmod, Real modulator
In 4: type=input: imod, Imag modulator
Return 1: USB, Upper sideband output
Return 2: LSB, Lower sideband output
Return 3: cosp, Cosine audio component
Return 4: sinp, Sine audio component
